_comment: Phase 5 foreclosure timeline thresholds/points. Unlike Phase 4's tax-deed timeline, there is no scraped foreclosure-sale-calendar source with an exact date, so this is built from two real, verified judicial milestones already in `documents`: the Lis Pendens filing date (cat='foreclosure') and, once one exists, the Final Judgment date (doc_type in RPO/VA FINAL JUDGMENT, cat='judgment'). No exact days-until-sale is ever claimed -- only real elapsed time since a real recorded milestone.
_judgment_recent_days_comment: Florida Statute 45.031 requires the clerk to schedule the sale not less than 20 nor more than 35 days after a final judgment of foreclosure -- 45 adds a small buffer for scheduling variance before treating the judgment as 'stale' (statutory window likely passed, outcome unverified).

runway_points._comment: Out of dealability_weights.json's max_points.closing_runway (20). A fresh Lis Pendens with no judgment yet is genuinely uncertain (case duration varies from months to years) so it scores moderate, not high or low; a recently entered judgment means a sale is likely imminent by statute even without an exact date, so it scores low like Phase 4's TAX_STAGE_IMMINENT.
